spanish: Porque echaré naciones de delante de ti, y ensancharé tu límite, y no codiciará varón tu tierra en tu subir a ser visto rostro de Jehová tu Dios tres veces en el año.
grammarChanges: Replaced the leftover English word 'faces' with the Spanish noun 'rostro' for פְּנֵי (h02034024016); no other token's rendering was touched.
readerNote: Rendered the plural-construct פְּנֵי as singular 'rostro', matching this translation's existing rendering of the same construct elsewhere (e.g., 'rostro de Jehová' in Job and Zacarías), rather than a literal plural 'rostros'.
